info.name: Fleet Ride API v2.0.0
info.description:
Model-backed contract for the Fleet Ride rider app, derived from `docs/API_MODEL_MAPPED.md` (every attribute is a real column verified against `docs/Models/*.php` and `docs/migrations/*.php`).

Transport: REST/HTTPS + a Socket.IO realtime gateway (handshake `auth:{ token, country }`; receive-only + subscribe/unsubscribe, all actions are REST) for the live trip — see `docs/realtime (1).md` and `docs/RIDER_REALTIME_EVENTS.md`. Every REST response uses the `ApiResponse` envelope (Socket.IO frames are raw, not enveloped).

Money: **integer minor units** (`*_minor`) paired with a sibling `currency_code` (`currencies.code`, e.g. `QAR`, `decimals=2`). Legacy `double` money columns are never used by this API.

Localization: send `Accept-Language: en | ar`; the resolved language is persisted per user (`rider_profiles.locale`, fallback `users.current_country`) and echoed as `locale` on every response. Bilingual `*_ar`/`*_en` columns are collapsed server-side to the single resolved string.

Payments: Stripe. Raw PAN/CVV never reach Fleet Ride — cards are tokenized client-side. Add-card = SetupIntent; pay/top-up = PaymentIntent (3DS/SCA via `requiresAction`).

Set the `baseUrl` and `accessToken` collection variables. All requests inherit Bearer auth from the collection except the public auth endpoints.
